hook_line: SENSEX SURGES 905 POINTS, NIFTY TOPS 22,900 AS BANKING AND FMCG STOCKS LEAD

hook_stat.sub: Points the Sensex jumped on Thursday

stats.label: Rise in Adani Ports, the top Sensex gainer

diaspora_bullets: Banking and FMCG stocks led the rally
Foreign investors bought Rs 872 crore of shares
news_summary: The BSE Sensex jumped 905.01 points, or 1.24%, to close at 74,151.04 on Thursday, while the NSE Nifty rose 237.90 points to 22,936.75.
payoff: The short-term outlook stays positive while the Nifty holds above 22,800.
